instructions:
Unified Hi-Fi Control MCP Server - Control Your Music System

Use hifi_zones to list available zones, hifi_now_playing to see what's playing, hifi_control for playback control, hifi_search to find music, and hifi_play to play it.

Note: hifi_search and hifi_play currently work with Roon and LMS zones only. Transport controls (play/pause/next/volume) work with all zones (Roon, LMS, OpenHome, UPnP).

To build a playlist: call hifi_play multiple times with action='queue'. The first track can use action='play' to start playback, then subsequent tracks use action='queue' to add to the queue.
